holderQuote: Eldavin whirled as the [Mages] cried out. He lifted a hand.
effectQuote: The splintered wood and broken plates—even bits of food rose in a whirling arc. Cognita, shielding the students, slowly rose. She saw a ten-foot-tall being assemble itself. It began to run at Archmage Feor. A Golem made of bits of wood and detritus.
